sections.title: Leveling Up
sections.description: After you survive at least one Fight with a monster and @Rest, you can level up by testing one of your stats **or** gain 1 additional @Insight
sections.mechanics: Roll 1d10 against 1 chosen stat (@Body, @Agility, @Focus, or @Fate). If the roll is **higher** than your current stat value, increase that stat by 1.
sections.limits: Maximum stat value is 9. If all your stats are at 9.

sections.title: Equipment & Gear
sections.description: Hunters carry specialized equipment into every hunt. A hunter may carry up to 5 items at a time. Equipment comes in two tiers — Low Pay and High Pay — and is acquired between hunts based on how dangerous (and lucrative) the job was.
rules: Character creation: choose 1 low-tier weapon and 4 additional low-tier items.
After a hunt with high pay: each hunter may acquire 1 high-tier item (including Trick Weapons).
After a hunt with low pay: resupply up to 5 low-tier items.
Maximum carry capacity is 5 items at all times.

types.name: Low Pay
types.description: Standard hunter equipment. Available at character creation and during resupply after any hunt.

types.name: High Pay
types.description: Rare and powerful equipment, including Trick Weapons. Acquired only after hunts with high pay.

sections.title: Insight
sections.description: All hunters start with 1 Insight. You can reroll any tests a number of times equal to your Insight quantity per day. Insight resets after a @Nights Rest.
sections.perception: Insight allows you to see hidden creatures, lights, and objects that others cannot perceive. Higher Insight reveals more about the cosmos and threats to mankind.
